Gate queues and a useful reminder
The desk is glad to help this weekend

Travelers should check in early and keep all animal papers ready before approaching the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Head and leash your pet calmly when you come forward, and follow the guidance from our trained staff so the handover stays smooth and safe. We are prepared to assist with routine travel arrangements, crate checks, and other common needs at the counter, and we will give patient attention to every animal in our care. If you are traveling with a companion animal, please keep the carrier secure and the details clear so the process remains orderly for everyone.

Aurelia Skyways serves passengers between skyports, and the desk works to keep each departure steady even when the gate area is busy. Travelers may ask for help with check-in steps, document review, and general boarding advice, and our team will respond in a calm and practical manner. For a comfortable start to the journey, please allow enough room for your pet to settle and stay close to the counter while arrangements are completed.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for assistance and guidance.
